# B2B SaaS Starter

Public documentation generated from the MDX collection. Article bodies are English; /nb navigation does not translate them. URLs are origin-relative.

## Start with a task

- [Run locally](/agent-docs/getting-started/quickstart.md): Install, seed, and run the starter locally.
- [Add a business feature](/agent-docs/getting-started/first-business-feature.md): Add workspace notes with D1 persistence, Effect adapters, permissions, an authenticated page, and REST.
- [Understand the architecture](/agent-docs/architecture/overview.md): How the web worker, API worker, background worker, D1, conversation Durable Objects, and Effect capabilities fit together.
- [Configure optional providers](/agent-docs/getting-started/optional-providers.md): How env-gated providers work; exact variables, where to set them, and how to verify activation.
- [Deploy to Cloudflare](/agent-docs/getting-started/cloudflare-deployment.md): Deploy the starter to Cloudflare Workers, D1, Durable Objects, Queues, and Email Service using Alchemy.
- [Call the REST API](/agent-docs/capability-interfaces/rest-api.md): Effect HttpApi exposed by the API Worker, generated OpenAPI, and the error model.
- [Connect an MCP client](/agent-docs/capability-interfaces/mcp-server.md): The same capabilities exposed as MCP tools and resources for AI clients, with OAuth for people and API Tokens for scripts.
- [Check workspace permissions](/agent-docs/governance/workspace-roles.md): Owner, admin, and member; the three Workspace Roles in the starter.

## Complete collection

- [Article index](/agent-docs/index.json): stable IDs, titles, canonical URLs, source paths and SHA-256 digests of the exact Markdown bytes.
- [All articles](/llms-full.txt): full English article content.
